title: Asymptotic Shift Thresholds for Polya-Schur Multipliers and a Certified Lower Bound on the de Bruijn-Newman Constant of the Davenport-Heilbronn Function

certified_theorems.name: Sufficient Stieltjes Shift Conditions on Polya-Schur Multipliers & Lacunary Root-Gap Obstruction
certified_theorems.verification: Conjugate-diagram Borel-Laplace cap asymptotics (generalizing Dobner 2021), single-zero syndetic Dirichlet translation avoiding Righetti (2017) non-density, diagonal Bohr compactness + seamless Rouche rectangles on tau > 2*sigma* - 1, subproduct extraction under w_{j+1} - w_j = o(sqrt(w_j)), and tower-lacunary counterexample R_1 = 16, R_k = 2^(2^(R_{k-1}))

certified_theorems.name: Global Doubling Bound and Strict Threshold Separation for Polya's Hyperbolic Sinc Multiplier
certified_theorems.verification: 320-bit Arb IVT enclosure of sigma* (r = 10^-30), singularity-free 384-bit 360-ball Arb Interval-Newton continuation across all h in [0, 5/8] near rho_44838 (plus r = 10^-30 point enclosures at h = 5/8 = 0.625 and h = 625121/10^6 = 0.625121), and computer-free interval-splitting doubling proof h_global*(G_sinc; Xi_DH) <= 2*sigma* - 1 = 1.240724996...

certified_theorems.name: Conditional Finiteness at the Critical Sinc Boundary h_* = sigma* - 1/2 under RH and GRH
certified_theorems.verification: Unconditional N_off >= 8 via Arb ball Interval-Newton enclosures at H_* = [sigma* - 1/2] near rho_2442 and rho_44838 (r = 10^-27); conditional N_off < infinity under RH for zeta(s) and GRH for L(s, chi_{5,quad}) via smoothed Mellin prime-angle bound theta_kappa - Phi(sigma* + i*gamma) >> (log gamma)^(-3/10) and Borel-Laplace cap tail O((log gamma)^(-1)) beating D_DH lower bound >> (log gamma)^(-1/3)

certified_theorems.name: Gauss-Weierstrass Height Cutoff and Ki-Kim-Lee Strict Upper Bound Lambda_DH < 2*(sigma* - 1/2)^2
certified_theorems.verification: Shifted Gauss-Weierstrass contour analysis (theta = pi*t/8), explicit Abel bound < 4*sqrt(tau), and Davenport-Heilbronn adaptation of Ki-Kim-Lee (2009) finite-box hyperbola argument

certified_theorems.name: Certified Lower Bound Lambda_DH > 28825920237/125000000000 via 512-Bit Interval-Newton Enclosure
certified_theorems.verification: 512-bit FLINT/Arb Gauss-Legendre ball quadrature with third-order derivative Taylor enclosure (radius 10^-32) near rho_240 at exact rational t = 28825920237/125000000000 = 0.230607361896
